title: Printed Page
description: Physical representation of a newspaper or typescript page as recognized by an OCR engine.

id.description: Canonical ID of the newspaper or typescript page, for example `GDL-1900-01-02-a-p0001` or `SOC_CJ-1940-07-22-a-p0001`.

iiif.description: URI of the IIIF manifest for the newspaper page image. Deprecated in favor of `iiif_img_base_uri`, which should be used whenever it is defined. Kept for backward compatibility.

iiif_img_base_uri.description: Base URI of the IIIF image for the newspaper page image. Should follow the format `{scheme}://{server}/{prefix}/{identifier}` and not include any suffix.

fw.description: Width in pixels of the facsimile corresponding to this page.

fh.description: Height in pixels of the facsimile corresponding to this page.

st.description: Type of source represented by this page. Should be a value from the `impresso_essentials.utils.SourceType` enum.

sm.description: Original production medium of the source represented by this page.

cc.description: Indicates whether legacy coordinates have been converted, or rescaled when necessary, to be IIIF-compliant.

cdt.description: Creation timestamp of the JSON file.

ts.description: Creation timestamp of the JSON file, in `%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ` format.

l.description: Lines of text belonging to the paragraph.

c.description: Coordinates of the image region for the line.

t.description: Tokens (as detected by the OCR engine).

c.description: Coordinates of the image region for the token.

s.description: Style ID as defined in `issue.schema.json` under `s`.

gn.description: Indicates whether the token should be followed by whitespace. `gn == true` means no whitespace is required (`gn` stands for `glue next`). When omitted, it is assumed to be `false`.

hy.description: Indicates whether the token is the first part of a hyphenated word, including the hyphen. When omitted, it is assumed to be `false`.

nf.description: Specified on the later part or parts of a hyphenated word. Contains the normalized, dehyphenated form.

pOf.description: Canonical ID of the content item to which the page region belongs.

section_pOf.description: Canonical IDs of the content items that compose the section to which the page region belongs. Used only when the region corresponds to a section title.

coordinates.description: Bounding-box coordinates following the IIIF region schema: `[x, y, width, height]` or `[HPOS, VPOS, WIDTH, HEIGHT]`.
